Richard, Jerry, and Robert are going to share 80 cherries. If Robert has 40 cherries, and has 20 more than Richard, how many more cherries does Robert have than Jerry?

Hannah has a mental breakdown while studying for finals and starts smashing windows in the high school's parking lot. She smashes a third of the students' cars' windows and half of the professors' cars' windows. If there are 80 students' cars with six windows each and 40 professors' cars with three windows each, how many windows does Hannah smash?

Tobias, Chikote, and Igneous are the three little wolves who live in the forest and howl at the moon every night. When Tobias howls, each howl lasts for a total of 30 seconds. Chikote howls for twice as long as Tobias. And Igneous howls for as long as the other two wolves combined. What is the combined length of time, in minutes, of the three wolves' howls?

Tom decides to give his wife an anniversary getaway. The plane tickets cost $4000 each. The hotel is 30% more expensive than normal because it is a busy weekend. The normal price is $2000 per day. If they are there for 4 days how much did the trip cost?
Axel has 70 silver pesos and 90 gold pesos. He visits his friend Anna who has twice as many silver pesos as he has and 50 more gold pesos. What's the total number of pesos they have together?

On Thursday, Joe caught 4 pounds of crawfish.  He caught 5 times that amount on Friday and half the amount of his Friday's catch on Saturday.  If 1 serving of crawfish is 2 pounds, how many servings does he have?

Mark decides to buy packs of old magic cards and open them to sell. He buys 4 packs for $2000 each. He gets 1 card that is worth $5000 and another card worth $1500. There are 40 more cards worth an average of $60 each. How much money profit did he make?

Ophelia and Jenna are living in the same apartment building. They each have 3 fewer sofas than chairs. Jenna has 4 times as many chairs as Ophelia. If Ophelia has 15 sofas, calculate the total number of sofas and chairs that they have.

A farmer is baling hay in their field. Each hour the farmer makes 7 bales. At the same time, a truck is picking the hay bales up. Each hour the truck picks up 4 bales of hay. If the farmer and the truck driver put in a 8 hour day, how many bales of hay are left in the field?

James decided to walk to the grocery store. When he got halfway there, he realized he forgot something at home and had to walk back. If his home is 6 miles from the store and he walks 3 miles per hour, how long did it take him to reach the store?
Frankie and Binkie went bowling together. Frankie's score was 20 better more than twice as high as Binkie's. If Binkie bowled a score of 80, what was Frankie's score?

A shop sells school supplies. One notebook is sold at $1.20 each, a pen at $0.15 each, a calculator at $15 each, and a geometry set at $12. How much does Daniel have to spend on all the items he wants to buy?

Tim decides to light off some fireworks for the fourth of July. He buys a package of fireworks worth $500 and another pack worth twice that much. He gets a 25% discount on them. He also buys a finale firework that costs $200. How much did he spend in total?

The expenditure of Joseph in May was $700. In June, his expenditure was $80 less. How much was his total expenditure for those two months?

There are thirty apples in one box. Uncle Franky ordered three boxes of apples. He is planning to pack the apples with six apples in one pack. How many packs of apples can he make with the three boxes of apples?

Lana is brewing cups of tea for her friends. She has 36 cups, and she arranges these into 4 rows. In each row, she makes equal amounts of chamomile and mint tea cups. She then uses the remaining cups to brew a total of 20 cups of cinnamon tea. How many cups of mint tea are in each row?

Sasha and Julie are best friends playing on opposing basketball teams. The teams have three practice games scheduled. In the first game, Sasha had the home court advantage and scored 20 points. Julie scored 5 fewer points than Sasha in the same game. Sasha always struggles during away games and their second match was at Julie's home court. Sasha scored 7 fewer points in the second game than Julie's score in the first game. How many total points did Sasha score during both games?

Ted the T-Rex was planning to bring potato salad to the dinosaur picnic.  He knows that an adult dinosaur will eat 16 lbs of potato salad, and a child will eat half as much as an adult.  If there will be 25 adults and 8 children at the picnic, how many pounds of potato salad does Ted need to bring to the picnic if he hopes to have enough to feed everyone?
James buys a ring for his bride-to-be.  The diamond cost $800 and the gold cost $400.  He pays a 20% premium for it to be made.  How much did he pay?
A cat eats nine sausages in 45 minutes. A dog can eat the same number of sausages in 3/5 the amount of time the cat takes. Calculate the average time the two take the eat the sausages.

Vicki is organizing a pop concert at her college. The show will last 3 hours. She is allowing each band 3 minutes to get on stage, 7 minutes to perform, and then 3 minutes to exit the stage. If she includes a 15-minute intermission, how many bands can perform in the concert?

Brinley is in Mr. Bert's math class. Mr. Bert gives six tests each semester. He allows the students to remove the lowest score from the average each semester. If Brinley has scores of 91, 73, 94, 102, and 88 on the first five tests, what score does she need on the sixth test to get an average of 95?

Morgan's dad said that she had $80 budgeted for her birthday party. The Go-karts cost $15 a ride. How many friends can she invite?

Donny can only drink water if it's at least 50 degrees. He has two mugs of water. One mug is 43 degrees. The other is an unknown temperature. If he pours 3 ounces of water from the 33-degree mug into his water bottle and one ounce from the other bottle, he is now able to drink the water.  At least how many degrees is the second bottle?

Nik has 300 crayons. He wants to separate them into groups of 6 and put them into boxes.  Each box weighs 8 ounces. Each crayon weighs 2 ounce. If he puts all of his crayons into boxes, what is the total weight, in pounds, of the crayons and the boxes, when there are 16 ounces to a pound?

Mrs. Harrington bought 15 boxes of oranges at the market. She gave her mom and her sister 3 boxes of oranges each. Then she kept 1/3 of the oranges and sold the rest. How many oranges did Mrs. Harrington sell if each box contains 25 oranges?
Dax went to their farm to pick some apples and found half as many bugs as ants in the garden. If there were 80 ants, calculate the total number of insects in the garden.
James has 32 teeth. His dentist drills 5 of them and caps 6 more teeth than he drills. What percentage of James' teeth does the dentist fix?

John decides to get a loan by mortgaging his home. His house is worth $500,000. He gets a loan worth 30% of that. He uses 50% of that to pay off his debts. How much money did he have leftover after paying debt?

Matt wants cookies for a snack, but his dad wants him to eat healthily. He tells Matt he can have half as many cookies as the number of carrot sticks he eats, plus three extra for cleaning his room. If Matt wants to eat seven cookies in total, how many carrot sticks does he have to eat?
Tom's restaurant receives 8 reservations a night. They normally order 3 meals that cost $7 each and a $6 bottle of wine. How much do they make a week if they are open 3 days a week?

Ava and Emma want to know who is better at the new video game Ava got for her birthday. They are each going to play one level and whoever has the highest score wins. If Ava jumps on 9 more enemies than Emma and collects 4 more berries, but finishes the level 5 seconds slower, what is the difference between their two scores?
Ben bought a car for $25000 in 2007. The price of the car depreciates at a constant rate of 12% per year. Find the price of the car in the year 2010.

Mel uses a 800-watt air conditioner for 6 hours a day. This means that each hour the AC uses 800 watts of energy. If he reduces the time he uses the air conditioner by 4 hours a day, how many kilowatts of electric energy will he save in 30 days?

Alex, Stan, and Adelwolfe are trying to catch them all, Pokemon that is.  Together they have caught 418 Pokemon.  Alex has caught 6 more than Stan, and Stan has caught 14 less than 5 times as many as Adelwolfe has caught. How many Pokemon has Stan caught?

Max bought stamps at the post office. Some of the stamps had a snowflake design, some had a truck design, and some had a rose design. Max bought 15 snowflake stamps. He bought 5 more truck stamps than snowflake stamps, and 8 fewer rose stamps than truck stamps. How many stamps did Max buy in all?

Kelian has two recipes for preparing dishes, one having 30 instructions and the second one having twice as many instructions as the first one. How many instructions does Kelian have to read to prepare the two dishes?
Dylan needed chicken sausages and fish sausages to make sausage buns at a party. He bought 45 chicken sausages and 7 more fish sausages than chicken sausages. How many sausages did Dylan buy in all?

Bud prepares homemade macaroni and cheese twice a week. The pasta costs $2.00 a box, and he spends $6.00 on cheddar cheese and twice that amount for the gruyere cheese. How much money does Bud spend on making macaroni and cheese in one year?

On a specific week, a tow truck pulled fifteen cars for each of the first four days and then five fewer cars on each of the remaining days of the week. Calculate the total number of cars it towed that week.

Ashley has an internet connection speed of 30kb per second. Knowing that 1 Mb has 1000 kb, she wants to know her internet connection speed in Mb per hour. What is Ashley’s internet connection speed in Mb per hour?

If all of the family show up at the family reunion, how many great grand-babies will be there for Great Grandma Smith to kiss?
Tom's ship can travel at 15 miles per hour. He is sailing from 2 to 5 PM. He then travels back at a rate of 9 mph. How long does it take him to get back?

If one pair of heels costs $42 and the other costs twice as much, how many dollars are the boots?
A raspberry bush has 8 clusters of 15 fruit each and 45 individual fruit scattered across the bush. How many raspberries are there total?
If a bag of marbles costs $30 and the price increases by 15% of the original price every three months, how much would a box of marbles cost after 24 months?
Annika brought $70 to the town fair. She spent two-thirds of it on food and snacks, and an additional $15 for rides. How much, in dollars, is left?

The heavy rainfall caused a flood in the marshland and swept Freddie Frog 300 yards away from his dwelling in the bog. To get back home, he will have to leap and paddle his way back. If he leaps on land at a speed of 30 yards per minute, and paddles through water at a speed of 15 yards per minute, how long will it take Freddie, in minutes, to return home if half of the distance is on land and the other half is in water?

If Vanessa ran 6 miles and Aaron completed his part of the race in 24 minutes, how long in minutes did Vanessa take to complete her part?
